name: – Recital K – Am 15
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the joint communication on humanitarian aid (JOIN(2026)0025)
part_text: K. whereas forced displacement is reaching unprecedented levels and a significant proportion of the world’s refugees and internally displaced persons reside in low-income and fragile states, placing increasing demands on humanitarian assistance and protection services; whereas the EU is facing countless challenges in connection with uncontrolled migration; whereas access to EU support should be conditional upon full, verifiable and continuous cooperation on the prevention of illegal migration, the combating of smuggling and trafficking networks, and the effective return and readmission of persons who do not qualify for international protection or who have no right to remain in the EU;
